description: This Java class defines the EncounterProvider model, mapping the relationship between Encounters and Providers in the OpenMRS medical record system. It includes fields for encounter, provider, and encounter role, along with common getter, setters, and a copy method.

classes.name: EncounterProvider
classes.description: Mapping class between Encounters and Providers with a many-to-many relationship, including properties for encounter, provider, encounter role, and metadata methods.

methods.name: setEncounterProviderId
methods.description: Sets the identifier for the EncounterProvider relationship.

methods.name: getEncounterProviderId
methods.description: Retrieves the identifier for the EncounterProvider relationship.

methods.name: getEncounter
methods.description: Returns the Encounter associated with this provider entry.

methods.name: setEncounter
methods.description: Sets the Encounter associated with this provider entry.

methods.name: getProvider
methods.description: Retrieves the Provider associated with this encounter.

methods.name: setProvider
methods.description: Assigns the Provider to this encounter.

methods.name: getEncounterRole
methods.description: Returns the specific role of the provider during the encounter.

methods.name: setEncounterRole
methods.description: Sets the role of the provider in the encounter.

methods.name: copy
methods.description: Creates and returns a deep copy of the EncounterProvider object with all relevant data duplicated.
